## How I tested it

<!-- You MUST play-test in a browser. Describe what you checked. -->

- [ ] Ran locally (`npx http-server -p 8000 -c-1`) and played the affected part
- [ ] Checked level transitions / retry / pit-fall if physics or level code changed
- [ ] Verified on a narrow (mobile) viewport if UI/controls changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/…`, `fix/…`, `chore/…`, or `docs/…`
- [ ] No secrets/tokens committed
- [ ] `main` stays deployable (this doesn't half-break the live game)
- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
